modmenu.descriptionTranslation.skin-tote: Simple Fabric mod which replaces all totems with player dolls. Just rename your totem to player's nickname in anvil to use it's skin!
skin-totem.modmenu.title: &lSkinTotem

skin-totem.modmenu.category.general.name: &lGeneral
skin-totem.modmenu.group.main.name: &lMain
skin-totem.modmenu.option.mod_enabled.de: If enabled, all totems will be replaced with player dolls; if disabled, won't.
skin-totem.modmenu.option.support_other_: If enabled, doll models will be applied to other mods totems too; if disabled, won't.
skin-totem.modmenu.option.debug_log_enab: If enabled, additional info will be logged to console for debugging; if disabled, won't.
Parallel Tasks Settings which may affect performance!
skin-totem.modmenu.option.parallel_tasks: Sets how many parallel tasks can be run for mod tasks, such as parallel downloading skins.
skin-totem.modmenu.group.auto_refresh.de: Settings for automatically refreshing cached skins.
skin-totem.modmenu.option.auto_refresh_e: If enabled, cached skins will be automatically refreshed at the chosen interval; if disabled, won't.
skin-totem.modmenu.option.auto_refresh_i: Sets how often (in minutes) cached skins should be automatically refreshed.
skin-totem.modmenu.group.right_hand.name: &lRight Hand
skin-totem.modmenu.group.left_hand.name: &lLeft Hand
skin-totem.modmenu.option.scale.name: Scale
skin-totem.modmenu.option.scale.descript: Sets the size of the doll model held in this hand.
skin-totem.modmenu.option.rotation_x.des: Sets the rotation of the doll model around the X axis (pitch).
skin-totem.modmenu.option.rotation_y.des: Sets the rotation of the doll model around the Y axis (yaw).
skin-totem.modmenu.option.rotation_z.des: Sets the rotation of the doll model around the Z axis (roll).
skin-totem.modmenu.option.offset_x.name: Offset X
skin-totem.modmenu.option.offset_y.name: Offset Y
skin-totem.modmenu.option.offset_z.name: Offset Z
skin-totem.modmenu.option.copy_right_han: Copies the current Right Hand rendering settings (scale, rotation, offset) to this hand.
skin-totem.modmenu.option.copy_left_hand: Copies the current Left Hand rendering settings (scale, rotation, offset) to this hand.
skin-totem.modmenu.option.use_vanilla_to: If enabled, the original vanilla Totem of Undying model will be rendered instead of the doll model.
skin-totem.modmenu.option.standard_doll_: Enter the Ely.by nickname in the "Skin Value" field.
Enter the TLauncher nickname in the "Skin Value" field.
Enter the player's name in field "Skin Value" to apply his skin to doll.
Each doll will have the skin of the player holding it. If no one is holding the doll, will be used Steve.
Enter the link to the skin in field "Skin Value" to apply your skin to doll.
Enter the path to the skin in field "Skin Value" to apply your skin to doll.
Path to the custom doll model file to use instead of the default one.
Sets whether the doll model uses wide (classic) or slim (Alex) player arms.
skin-totem.tags.info.title: &lWhat is this?
skin-totem.tags.info.text:
This is the &eDoll Tags Menu&f.
In this menu you can find list of &ebuttons&f.
By clicking on the buttons, you can &echange appearance&f of your totem. For example: &eDisable/enable certain parts&f, &eselect custom model&f, etc.

skin-totem.tags.tips.text:

 &e&l2. &rUse command &7/skintotem refresh [...]&r to refresh doll skins.
